ModelMetadata.Description: Healthcare IoT Testbed - Users table and single-table Metadata table. Entities: DEVICE, ARTIFACT (all uploaded and produced files, incl. firmware; firmware versions unique per device via DEVICE#/FWVER# guard rows), BATCH (upload batches), MODULE (scripts; runtime cloud|local) with VERSION#n, ENV (tool environments; platform ones listed under PLATFORM) with VERSION#n, RUN (cloud Batch executions) with CHILD# (jobs and their work units), RESULT#{unitId} and ARTIFACT# links both ways, ACTIVE#RUNS for the watchdog, SESSION (interactive JupyterLab only), per-user BUDGET (numeric, versioned) and USAGE#{period}# ledger. Ownership is stored as two-way USER#/X# + X#/USER# links with role=owner only. Device links are optional. See Platform/infra/DATABASE.md.

description.S: Extracts config blocks and strings from BP monitor firmware
Runs binwalk extraction on each input file (calls binwalk from Python)
Captures BLE traffic with an nRF sniffer dongle on the user's machine
Flashes nRF52 boards over SWD from the user's machine (local script)
Analysis base plus radare2, GDB and Ghidra
Python 3.12 with tshark, binwalk, scapy, dpkt, pyshark, lief, pyelftools, capstone, yara-python, pandas and unblob
